title: 第10章 让你小子高光了？
slug: 我在致郁番里画热血番
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

下午考试的时候，阴雨绵绵。

这个雨似乎是从江黛在跟自己说话的时候就开始下了，一直也没停过。

阴雨的天气，整个教室里都阴沉沉的，班级里其他人明显焦躁许多。

真特么阴间的考试。

考锤子。

随便填填得了。

贺舟也大概明白为什么考试会容易招来妖魔。

本身考试就烦了，还得死人，这谁的心态能吃得消？

越烦怨气越重越容易有妖魔，越相信妖魔，妖魔越会爬出来。

“好家伙！闭环！”

“这个世界特么是唯心主义啊！”

看着贺舟想收拾东西跑，旁边路安坐在窗边，扭头看过来，带着要赴约一般的淡然。

“放弃考试会被标记。”

“谁定的规则？”

“大家。”

路安看着贺舟没明白，又补充了一句：“人把恐惧说了一千遍，它就变成了筛选我们的规则。”

“规则从来就出自大众。”

这里真是没一个说人话的活人！！

贺舟沉默了片刻才发现…

这里确实没活人啊！

严格意义上来说，他们算是纸片人！

可是老子竟然听懂了这谜语人的意思！

这就是来自谜语人的同化吗！

恐怖如斯！

在发试卷的过程中。

贺舟有些坐立难安。

在兑换了警觉耳之后，甚至都能听到微弱的一汩汩的怨气飘散到空中的声音。

嘶嘶嘶…

整个墙上都像是有一团空气撞过去，莫名能听到利爪从空中伸出来划在墙上的嘶拉声。

那种声音很微妙。

就像是两个世界叠在了一起，声音悠远却又飘忽，不仔细听完全听不见。

越仔细听，越是明显。

灯光越是晃动。

那细长的白炽灯的影子就拉得越长。

嘶吼、流动粘稠的空气、表情麻木死气沉沉的同学，和台上淡定监考的老师。

贺舟倒吸了口凉气，看着关上的门，和试卷上荒谬的【雾岛八中数学试卷】几个字，和正儿八经的题目，十分无语。

你们就不知道变通变通吗？

在这样随时要命的环境下，谁有心思搁这做题目？

贺舟奋笔疾书。

好在这些题目都很简单，只是十分钟不到，在感受到教室越来越危险之前，他就把全部的题目做完了。

刚想扭头把答案塞给旁边的小猫，就发现小猫已经眨巴着眼睛凑过来一笔一划地把答案都抄好了。

还挺机灵…

怪不得是田园猫。

这要是换成别的品种，指不定还没这么机灵。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

During the afternoon exam, it was rainy.

The rain seemed to have started falling when Jiang Dai was talking to herself, and it never stopped.

The weather was rainy, the whole classroom was gloomy, and other people in the class were obviously a lot more anxious.

What a damn exam.

Test the hammer.

You can fill it in casually.

He Zhou also probably understood why exams can easily attract demons.

The exam itself is annoying, and people have to die. Who can bear this mentality?

The more annoyed and resentful you are, the more likely you are to have demons. The more you believe in demons, the more likely they will come out.

"Good guy! Close the loop!"

"This world is so idealistic!"

Seeing He Zhou trying to pack up his things and run away, Lu An was sitting by the window and turned to look over, as calmly as if he was going to an appointment.

"Abandoning the exam will be flagged."

"Who makes the rules?"

"Everyone."

Lu An saw that He Zhou didn't understand, and added: "People have said fear a thousand times, and it becomes a rule for screening us."

"Rules have always come from the public."

There really isn’t a living person here who speaks human language!!

He Zhou was silent for a moment before realizing...

There is really no one alive here!

Strictly speaking, they are paper people!

But I actually understood what the Riddler meant!

Is this the assimilation from the Riddler!

So scary!

During the process of handing out test papers.

He Zhou was a little restless.

After exchanging alert ears, I could even hear a faint gurgling sound of resentment floating into the air.

Hisssssssssssssss…

The entire wall felt like a ball of air had hit it, and for some reason, the hissing sound of sharp claws stretching out from the air and scratching against the wall could be heard.

That sound is subtle.

It's like two worlds superimposed on top of each other. The sound is distant but erratic, and you can't hear it unless you listen carefully.

The closer you listen, the more obvious it becomes.

The lights shook more and more.

The shadow of the slender incandescent lamp becomes longer and longer.

The roaring, flowing and thick air, the classmates with numb and lifeless expressions, and the calm teacher on the stage invigilating the exam.

He Zhou took a breath and looked at the closed door, the ridiculous words "Kirishima No. 8 Middle School Mathematics Test Paper" on the test paper, and the serious questions, and was speechless.

Don’t you know how to be flexible?

In such an environment where someone could be killed at any moment, who would have the heart to put this aside and do the questions?

He Zhou wrote vigorously and quickly.

Fortunately, these questions were very simple. In less than ten minutes, he finished all the questions before he felt that the classroom was getting more and more dangerous.

Just when I was about to turn around and give the answer to the kitten next to me, I found that the kitten had already blinked and came over and copied the answer one stroke at a time.

Quite clever...

No wonder it’s a garden cat.

If it were another species, it might not be so clever.
